summary: The diff implements a name-only Login page, adds rank/leaderboard UI under frontend/src/rank, extends persisted frontend state with userProfile and streakMilestones, adds streak computation utilities, and adds Motoko backend methods for weekly ranking. However, several requirements/AC are only partially met, especially the exact streak milestone behavior/messages and backend addPoints/auth/error semantics.

missing_requirements.requirement: Streak computation must use local-time calendar dates stored in events, and milestone award messages must exactly match: “Congrats on your hat-trick! +5 points.” and “Congrats on your 6-day streak! +10 points.”
missing_requirements.reason: Streak uses `new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]` (UTC date) rather than local-date logic, and the toast messages differ from the required exact English strings (also includes emojis and extra wording).

missing_requirements.requirement: Points are not re-awarded for the same milestone within the same ongoing streak; streak milestone tracking must be stable for a streak.
missing_requirements.reason: The streak identifier is derived from `getStreakIdentifier(streakLength)` which uses the *current* streak length to compute a start date; as the streak length increases day by day, this identifier can change, risking re-award behavior for the same underlying streak.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend add-points method should succeed for authenticated callers and reject unauthenticated writes; it must correctly represent success/failure and update weekly points for the caller.
missing_requirements.reason: `addPoints` returns a `RankingError` variant but appears to always return `#displayNameUpdateFailed` even after updating the user data, and there is no explicit unauthenticated/anonymous principal rejection despite having a `#userNotAuthenticated` error type.

missing_requirements.requirement: When a milestone award occurs, frontend must increment local points and call backend to increment weekly points; backend failures must show an English non-blocking error without crashing, while keeping local points consistent.
missing_requirements.reason: The milestone award flow is truncated; the diff shows backend submission (`submitPoints`) but does not clearly show the required non-blocking error handling path and message for backend failure in the milestone-award code section.

hallucinated_features.description: Simulated async login behavior using `setTimeout` before calling onLogin.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-39 does not request simulated delays; it only requires validation and persistence.

hallucinated_features.description: Leaderboard UI includes decorative icons (Trophy/Medal/Award) and copy like “Top performers this week” and “Rankings reset every week. Keep your streak going to earn more points!”.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-42 requires a weekly leaderboard with rank/name/points and an empty state; additional iconography and motivational copy were not requested.
